injected_issues.description: About 0.5% of customer rows are duplicated exactly.
The 'city' column contains inconsistent casing and spelling for major cities (e.g., 'Mumbai', 'mumbai', 'MUMBAI', 'Bombay').
About 2% of customers are missing the 'acquisition_channel'.
A handful of subscriptions have an 'end_date' that is before the 'start_date'.
A very small number of usage rows have negative 'session_minutes'.
About 100 payment records reference a customer_id that does not exist in the customers table.
